**Issue #1658 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1658: Patch: a bar that fills and a reward reveal, on the token bars first
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Part of #1651 (brief §3). Today the token bars are text (`apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx` ~l.225: `Card token bar: 7 / 20`). This part builds the shared bar that fills and the reward reveal the other economy parts use, puts both token bars on it, and builds the opening's two-bar animation that the pack-opening scene mounts.

### The components (fixed: the opening, store and XP parts import them)
- `apps/web/src/economy/FillBar.tsx`, default export, props `{ label: string; size: number; value: number; from?: number; fills?: number; caption?: string; onFill?: (fill: number) => void; onDone?: () => void; testid?: string }`. `label` is already through `t()`; `size` and `value` are the server's. Without `from` it is drawn at `value` with no animation. With `from` it fills from `from` to `size`, bursts, calls `onFill(1)`, restarts at 0, does that again for each of `fills`, then fills to `value` and calls `onDone`. `caption` defaults to `{value} / {size}`, small secondary text; the bar is the main read. It always renders a native `<progress max={size} value={…}>` resting at `value` (screen readers, and e2e spec 45 reads a track's `progress`).
- `apps/web/src/economy/RewardReveal.tsx`, default export, props `{ items: readonly RevealItem[]; testid?: string; onDone?: () => void }`, with `RevealItem = { key: string; kind: 'cardToken' | 'cosmeticToken' | 'cosmeticPack' | 'jlore' | 'setPack' | 'level'; label: string; rarity?: string }`. The items fly out one by one, each with the existing sting (`getAudioEngine().playSfx`, as `packs/packs.ts::playStinger` plays it; no new sound file).
- `apps/web/src/economy/OpeningBars.tsx`, default export, props `{ bars: OpeningBarsAnswer; testid?: string }`. `OpeningBarsAnswer` comes from `net/api.ts`, which the bars-answer part adds: `{ card: { before, after, size, pays }, cosmetic: { before, after, size, pays }, cosmeticPaid: ('rare' | 'epic' | 'cosmeticPack')[] }`. It draws the card and the cosmetic token bar as FillBars (`from` before, `value` after, `fills` pays), only when a bar moved, and reveals each fill's reward as it bursts: a card token, or `cosmeticPaid[i]` (a Rare or an Epic cosmetic token, or a cosmetic pack). When nothing moved it draws nothing.
- `apps/web/src/economy/bars.ts`: the pure parts (the segments a fill plays, an opening's reveal items), with tests.

### Motion
Every animation is transform and opacity only (the fill a `scaleX`). Reduce motion holds every animation still and shows the end state at once, calling `onFill` for each fill and then `onDone` straight away. It reads both switches, as `cards/cosmetics.css` and `PackScene` do: the settings' Reduce motion (`:root[data-reduce-motion=true]`, `useSetting('reduceMotion')`) and the system's (`game/useOsReducedMotion.ts`; `game/animations.ts::reducedMotionNow` joins them).

### Files
New, under `apps/web/src/economy/`: `FillBar.tsx`, `RewardReveal.tsx`, `OpeningBars.tsx`, `bars.ts`, `economy.css`, `FillBar.test.tsx`, `OpeningBars.test.tsx`, `bars.test.ts`. And `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx` and `shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx`: both token bars become FillBars (no `from`), keeping `shopTestid.cardBar` and `shopTestid.cosmeticBar` on them, with `Next: {step}` beside the cosmetic bar. Add no test id to `shop/shop.ts` (the store part owns it).
Not here: `shop/Shop.tsx`, `shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`, `packs/*`.

### Done when
Component tests: a FillBar from 18 to 3 of 20 with one fill bursts once, calls `onFill(1)` and rests at 3 (its `<progress>` value 3); under reduced motion it shows 3 at once with `onFill` and `onDone` called; OpeningBars from an answer with `card.pays` 1 and `cosmeticPaid ['epic']` reveals a card token and an Epic cosmetic token, and draws nothing for an answer where neither bar moved; the TokenPicker draws both bars from `GET /api/tokens` with the server's points and size; a stylesheet test reads `economy.css`: its keyframes animate only `transform` and `opacity`, and reduce motion stills them. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/economy src/shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` (red on `OpeningBarsAnswer` until the bars-answer part lands: expected), `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`.

**Fullsend.** A part of #1651: it lands on `bot/issue-1651` with no checks or review of its own, beside the other parts. Change only the files named here. A check red only because a sibling part has not landed yet is expected. Leave to the reconcile the `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` entry of each new `t()` string, `apps/web/README.md`, and every e2e spec. Keep every existing test id.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-1651`, not `main` (fullsend).

Part of #1651, split by Night bot (`opus`, [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39819773251)).
```
